title: Passwords that only resemble a placeholder
summary: Connection URIs whose password imitates a placeholder but carries real-looking material: filler characters ending in a real-looking character, a placeholder word embedded in a long random value, or a placeholder word prefixed to one.
rationale: A placeholder rule that matches on a substring would silence any password containing the word password or secret. These values are built to contain such words and still hold a real-looking tail that must be covered.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. The placeholder exemption applies only to whole placeholder values; a value with a real-looking tail is a literal, and the range covers it entirely.
